CustomField.description: CE ID is the Customer Environment ID that identifies the Customer's instance in Tanium Cloud. The Provisioner process creates a unique CE ID for each instance that is created. The CE ID is unique and cannot change. It is a 1-to-1 relationship to a Server Deployment record. Multiple license ID's can be created against a single CE ID. The license ID's are stored on the Tanium Server License object. This field is used by Snowflake to link licenses to customers. Business Owner: Jeff Kopp
